quizzes.title: Asthma and Allergy: Anti-Allergen Cleaning and Treatment — Knowledge Check

questions.questionText: What does an allergen-denaturing treatment actually do?
options: Changes the allergen protein structure so the immune system no longer recognises it
Seals allergens under a plastic coating
Removes all humidity from the home

questions.questionText: Before applying an anti-allergen treatment to carpet you must always:
options: Test for colourfastness in an inconspicuous area
Remove all furniture from the house

questions.questionText: Which of these is a key Australian WHS control when applying treatment products?
options: Wearing the PPE specified by the product label and SDS

questions.questionText: The residual allergen relief commonly stated by manufacturers of allergen-denaturing treatments is up to:
When quoting an anti-allergen service in Australia you should:
options: Copy US pricing from the manufacturer
Quote in AUD from your own chemical cost per square metre and labour rate
Quote only after the job is done
